framework_decision.question: The ticket re-opened the framework question at E3 on its own merits: prose->atomic-assertion decomposition is the one place Ragas's headline differentiator (native claim decomposition) OR a native decomposition-judge applies; the ledger-diff is custom either way.
framework_decision.decision: NATIVE, again. The decomposition step is one bounded generative prompt on the existing substrate (judge.raw_invoke + strict dict-only JSON parse + hand-built provenance) — adopting Ragas for that single step would route judge calls outside the substrate's structural guarantees (Inferred typing, provenance-per-verdict, non-drafter independence) for a primitive reproducible in ~40 lines.
reasoning: API-currency guardrail still binding: ragas/deepeval/promptfoo remain absent from the offline build env; a real Ragas binding cannot be verified against current docs here.

The ledger-diff (materiality bar, lexical shortlist, batched numbered-candidate coverage, escalation, entry_key accounting) is custom logic no framework ships — the framework would cover only decomposition.
Substrate guarantees are load-bearing for an integrity metric: every E3 judge call flows through the pinned non-drafter Judge with provenance; a framework's own decomposition chain would not.
Earn-its-lane unchanged: DeepEval -> E5 (G-Eval) / E8 (DeepTeam), Ragas -> E9 (graph retrieval), PromptFoo -> E6/E7 — the lanes where a framework PRIMITIVE is irreplaceable.

claim_identity_decision.problem: Excellence's 191 claim_statuses entries concatenate ~34 independently-numbered drafting blocks: 128 unique ids, 43 duplicated ids, and mixed schemes (C-001, C-13-07, HOST, FELLOW, DURATION). C01 alone names three claims, two unrelated (entries 0/43: tomato crop selection — a true duplicate pair; entry 171: the fellow's identity). Nothing tags a claim to its sub-section. An id-keyed diff is therefore broken by construction, and shipped E2 surfaced findings under ambiguous bare ids.
claim_identity_decision.decision: Claims are identified by entry_key = claim_id + '#' + entry_index (position in the frozen claim_statuses array), e.g. 'C01#171'; bare claim_id only when no index exists (synthetic/test claims). E3 never matches by id: the ledger is a set of (claim_summary, status, source_ref) records, de-duplicated (9 true duplicate records in excellence) with ALL member entry_keys retained; the batched coverage judge answers with a candidate NUMBER (never an echo of an ambiguous id), mapped back locally.
claim_identity_decision.e2_disambiguation_pass: Shipped E2 amended additively and backward-compatibly: SectionClaim/ClaimFaithfulness/ClaimGroundingSnapshot gain entry_index + entry_key; load_section_claims populates the index; judge property_key, routing, and hard_finding_ids use entry_key. REAL BUG FIXED: FaithfulnessBaseline.by_id() keyed snapshots on bare claim_id, silently collapsing 191 real-data snapshots to 128 and mis-comparing the M3 invariance check; it now keys on entry_key (old baselines without entry_index still load — key falls back to claim_id). Existing synthetic-claim tests unchanged (entry_index defaults None); 6 new disambiguation tests.

decision_description: Delivered E3 as three modules on the E1/E1.5 substrate. (1) harness/materiality.py — the §10.5 materiality classifier (prompt quotes §10.5 verbatim; boolean verdict; same path in pipeline and calibration) + ledger-anchored calibration: positives auto-labeled from the engine's own claim summaries (393 deduped across the three sections — the ticket's 'the ledger says which'; not an AI-fabricated label), negatives shipped as 30 UNLABELED prose-drawn candidates for a human (E1.5 rule). Load-bearing guard: with zero labeled negatives, precision is forced to None — the raw confusion-matrix precision would be a spurious tp/(tp+0)=1.0 (bug caught in design review); recall over the positives is computable day one and bounds the missed-escape risk. (2) harness/claim_ledger.py — chunk (whole paragraphs, <=4KB, no overlap) -> decompose (judge, EXHAUSTIVE by prompt — materiality deliberately a separate classifier, defusing decomposition-filter circularity; strict dict-only JSON parse, no silent repair; hand-built decomposition provenance to an explicit ProvenanceLog param, the calibrate_with_judge precedent) -> dedup assertions (normalized text, origins kept) -> classify materiality -> match by meaning (deterministic lexical shortlist top-K, one batched judge call over NUMBERED candidates, escalation to the stricter per-candidate boolean when coverage is asserted but unattributable — a bounded re-ask, not repair). A material assertion no record covers is OUTCOME_ESCAPED — the hard 'fabricates without emitting a claim' finding — with its basis always recorded (no_lexical_candidates / judged_uncovered / escalation_unconfirmed) so a zero-overlap-paraphrase false escape is legible. Batch posture: per-assertion/per-chunk judge failures become unjudgeable findings / ChunkFailures (thousands of calls; aborting at call 900 would yield NO report); zero-assertion density anomalies and never-matched ledger records surfaced in notes. (3) harness/status_calibration.py — overclaimed (confirmed_not_grounded, HARD; reuses a supplied E2 StatusFaithfulnessResult at zero extra confirmed-direction judge calls, else runs E2 internally; E2-unresolved maps to unverifiable, never overclaimed) and underclaimed (inferred_fully_grounded, SOFT; the inferred claim judged under E2's confirmed standard, bar decided by E2's own meets_bar under DEFAULT_POLICIES['confirmed'] — boolean primary, score floor only under an N>=3 panel).
earn_its_lane_finding: Wave-0 decision-gate finding for E3: the metric surfaces the exact signal class no predicate or W1-style check can reach. In offline testing, an assertion about equipment absent from the ledger produced the OUTCOME_ESCAPED hard finding with the §10.5 framing, while a covered assertion resolved to the exact disambiguated entry_key of its ledger record; the status-calibration direction maps E2's real integrity finding to overclaimed drift and flags a fully-source-backed inferred claim as underclaimed. The distinct capability is the prose-side diff itself (decomposition + materiality + meaning-match) — none of it duplicates a deterministic predicate (routing enforced per assertion). Wave 0 is complete in one 'framework' (the native substrate). Whether to adopt a second framework in Wave 1 (E4/E5) is the next gate, evaluated then; E4 explicitly reuses E2's freeze/compare machinery natively.

code_review.method: /code-review — two axes (Standards + Spec) run as parallel general-purpose sub-agents against the working tree vs HEAD (af1795f).
code_review.spec_verdict: Compliant on all traced load-bearing paths (precision-None guard, fail-closed loaders, escaped-basis recording, entry_key consistency incl. baseline keying, temp-0/pinning on the raw_invoke path, blocking=False everywhere, no framework imports, e2-reuse zero-call). Three real gaps found — ALL FIXED:
code_review.spec_dispositions: (1) Report summary miscounted hard findings — a no_lexical_candidates escape contributed no report finding and an escalation_unconfirmed escape contributed a passed=True batched verdict, so HarnessReport.summary could count an escaped claim as passed/absent — FIXED: build_report now emits one derived per-assertion outcome verdict (escaped -> passed=False, covered -> True, non-material/unjudgeable -> inconclusive; still Inferred; stage verdicts remain on the finding + provenance), so summary.failed == escaped exactly (2 new tests). (2) Decomposition provenance was opt-in — the raw_invoke path bypassed the Judge's attached log, so the standard attach-a-log pattern silently produced no decomposition provenance — FIXED: Judge gains a read-only provenance_log property; decompose_chunk falls back to the attached log when no explicit one is passed (2 new tests). (3) Confirmed claims could drop silently under e2-reuse (an e2_result made with a claim_filter or for another section) — FIXED: section mismatch now raises StatusCalibrationError (the exception the standards axis had flagged as never-raised), and uncovered confirmed claims surface as DRIFT_UNVERIFIABLE rows (2 new tests). Scope-creep notes: sub_section_filter kept (mirrors E2's claim_filter; makes the real-data probe affordable); the pre-existing untracked harness_plan/EVAL_HARNESS_E3_PREAPPROVAL.md is NOT part of this change and is excluded from the commit.
